bottom_matches.release_note: (reliability) like a boomerang, bad penny, or persistent telemarketer, dms kept reappearing in the sidebar no matter how many times you tapped "close conversation." no means no, closed means closed, and fixed (we hope) means fixed.scrubbing through a video was scrubbing the progress bar clean off, making it impossible to go forward or back while the video was playing. since we can't press "rewind" on this bug, allow us to "fast-forward" to a fix with this update.if you were logged out via your workspace's session duration settings, you may have gotten a "sorry, an error occurred" message when attempting to log back in. while technically correct, that's not very helpful (the message or the being locked out). with this update, you may come and go as you please.

(efficiency) sharing into slack from third-party apps (such as the android photo gallery) was sometimes failing with the message "can't share content to the current workspace." after extensive testing in our labs, we've concluded that sharing is caring — and so is this fix.like a receipt for the wrong purchase, a media player notification was appearing in the drawer after tapping on an image in slack. weirder still, pressing play on the notification would begin playing audio or video from a separate file further back in the channel history. talk about stranger things. here's hoping we've seen the series finale of this bug.
bottom_matches.review: (efficiency) trash app. Don't work logging in.
